title: The F47 sterile right-handed neutrino as the model-native dark-matter relic

S1_genuine_sterile.Y_forced_by: Higgs-free Majorana mass U(1)_Y-invariance (F47 M2/M3) — not a free choice
S1_genuine_sterile.note: F47 nu_R is a total SM singlet; Y=0 forced by Higgs-free Majorana U(1)_Y invariance
S1_genuine_sterile._desc: F47 nu_R is a total SM singlet (Y=0 forced)

S2_long_lived.note: long-lived by ~9 orders; E_g amplitude mode was ~38 orders below age (F199)

S3_clusters_collisionless.free_streaming_caveat: keV -> WARM DM; Lyman-alpha sets m_s >~ few keV (non-resonant) / lower for resonant; clusters on galactic+ scales, suppresses sub-galactic structure
S3_clusters_collisionless.note: keV -> warm DM, clusters on galactic+ scales; only mixing coupling -> Bullet-compatible

S4_mixing_window.note: naive see-saw & DW-full X-ray excluded; resonant nuMSM benchmark allowed & stable
S4_mixing_window._desc: naive/DW X-ray excluded; resonant nuMSM allowed

S5_verdict.verdict: The model contains a GENUINE sterile state — the F47 right-handed neutrino, a total SM singlet with Y=0 structurally forced — and it passes every bar the E_g sector failed: stable (tau ~ 1e25-26 s, ~8 orders > age, vs E_g's 38 orders below), massive (clusters), collisionless (only tiny mixing). It is the nuMSM keV sterile neutrino, viable via resonant production in the X-ray/Lyman-alpha window, and is structurally tied to the F47 see-saw that already explains the small active-neutrino mass. The keV mass scale is ACCOMMODATED (free M_R), not yet derived — the remaining obstruction.
